single.rationale: FTAI shows exceptional revenue growth (52% 3-yr CAGR) in a highly specialized niche (CFM56/V2500 engine maintenance platform), with strategic evolution toward asset-light model via third-party capital partnerships. The deeply negative operating cash flow (-$311M in FY2025) despite revenue growth to $2.5B raises questions about working capital intensity and business model sustainability that warrant deeper investigation, but the Strategic Capital Initiative and internalization of management could fundamentally improve economics.

dropped.claim: FTAI Aviation has achieved exceptional revenue growth of 52.4% three-year CAGR through its engine MRE business model, but this growth has not translated into cash generation—operating cash flow deteriorated from $129.0M positive in 2023 to negative $310.7M in 2025, raising serious questions about business model sustainability despite the company's shift to asset-light third-party capital management through its $2.0B Strategic Capital Initiative.
